scope: Existing peak fixed lower-half workpiece node weak forces in N, at fixed body coordinates in mm. ON-body vectors are the original negative internal weak force. The original total holding reaction opposes ON-body total; component-wise holding glyphs are algebraic negatives for display, not independent reaction measurements. No pressure, continuous face traction, radial pressure projection, mirror doubling or qualified effective grip. Raw node/mask/group values retained. New sums/differences are descriptive only, without a tolerance or acceptance gate. No new F/T/HP/equilibrium/tests/default or API association. These three JSONs do not contain full deformed gripper coordinates.
